vision.name: Orange Cunning Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 life card. Whenever a Drill you own would be discarded due to your MP changing levels, you may Rejuvenate it instead.
[Instant] POWER: Use when you would use a critical damage effect during combat. Search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play instead.
POWER: Rejuvenate a Drill from your discard pile.
